people.name: Caleb Will Huftalin
people.title_or_status: DIRECTOR OF WEALTH MANAGEMENT/CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
people.bio_note: Founder and Director of Wealth Management, CFP. Graduate of Northern Illinois University College of Business. Prior to founding Ridgeline (initially in 2019, refounded/restructured in 2021-2022), worked as a Wealth Advisor (CFP) at Catalyst Wealth Management from 2011 to 2019. Based in the far East Valley near the Superstition Mountains; husband and father of four boys.

people.name: Stephen Daniel Hofmann
people.bio_note: Co-Owner/Managing Member and Director of Wealth Planning, holding JD, CPA, CFP, and PPC credentials — a rare combination of law, accounting, and financial planning expertise. Bachelor's in accountancy from Northern Illinois University; J.D. from Thomas M. Cooley Law School (2010-2012); licensed Illinois attorney and CPA. Previously worked at Baker Tilly Virchow Krause and Midland Wealth Management, with 12+ years in the investment and financial industry. Based in Northern Illinois, not Arizona (worth noting — Ridgeline operates virtually/nationwide); married father of four.
people.bio_source: LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/steve-hofmann), corroborated by AdvisorCheck regulatory profile (advisorcheck.com/advisor/6994818-stephen-daniel-hofmann-ridgeline-private-wealth-rockford-illinois) and Midland States Bank bio (midlandsb.com/node/3501)

firm_note.text: Ridgeline Private Wealth is a Mesa, AZ RIA operating as a nationwide virtual/location-independent advisory focused on business owners, specializing in tax reduction and investment strategy.
